method: Per-original-pixel row RGB minimum threshold 220/225/235 within manually inspected broad side-specific windows. Bright cores are not physical boundaries; uncertainty/bracket retained. Left/right independently measured, no forced mirror.
nulls: 125..149 cap neighborhood excluded from curve controls
175..205 main S and outer thin arc merge: center and S-only outer edge null
below275 and lower joint/terminal: not extrapolated
source02 upper/lower caps remain independent annotation null
